description: Write the title, description, canonical, Open Graph and Twitter tags for a web page, ready to paste into its <head>.

description.description: One or two sentences, about 155 characters at most.

image.description: Full address of a 1200 x 630 share image.

image_alt.description: A short description of the share image.

noindex.description: Ask search engines not to list the page. Defaults to false.

theme_color.description: A hex colour for the browser bar, such as #2f7cf6.

title.description: The page title, about 60 characters at most.

twitter.description: The site's X handle, with or without @.

url.description: The page's full address, used as the canonical and og:url.

name: head_tags
title: Make head tags
